title: On the Blind Spots of Model-Based Evaluation Metrics for Text Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the scores assigned by PLM-based evaluation metrics to text generated by their own underlying models versus text generated by other, sometimes larger or superior, language models.

Evaluating metrics on synthetic texts composed of randomly concatenated, highly frequent n-grams to see if the metrics unfairly assign higher scores to statistically frequent but incoherent text over coherent gold hypotheses.

Injecting synthetic errors (such as random or shuffled tokens) into different positions of a text (start, middle, and end) to measure if the evaluation metric's sensitivity is biased toward specific local contexts or positions.
